name: iacg-generate
purpose: The expert generation contract: consume the compiled capability brief and produce secure-by-default, well-structured Terraform. Checkov confirms; it does not drive.
never_do: run terraform apply / tofu apply or reach a cloud write API
invent a resource argument the pinned schema does not declare
add a resource to make a scanner quiet
claim the result is compliant, verified or ready

provenance.source_reference: Ports the V2 worker_prompt generation contract and the sealed cloud-aws / iac-authoring rule corpus into a lean CE generation skill driven by iacg_desk brief.
